audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Thundering Smash a 'dash-root' and tells you to 'Condemn him mid-Q to cancel the dash-root'. Riot's text says Volibear 'gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks' — it is a movement-speed ramp with a stun on his next attack, and the kit carries no dash flag.
audit.why: Advising a knockback to cancel a dash that does not exist sends you into his 300 range on a cooldown you cannot interrupt. It is also a stun, not a root, which changes what tenacity and spacing do.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, whys[2], mid, late, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0], dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d rewritten around the stun-on-next-attack and the 12s cooldown.
sources: enemyKit Q text and flags (hardCC, autoReset, no dash)

audit.whatIsWrong: Sky Splitter (E) appears nowhere in the matchup text.
audit.why: It is a 1200-range lightning bolt on 16s that slows and shields him if he stands in the blast — it is the reason his level-3 all-in beats yours and it eats your burst window.
audit.corrected: Added to phases[2].why, mid and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-5 all read 'Skill' in both layers while the packet chart is Volibear on 1, 2 and 4 and Vayne on 3 and 5, and the whys already describe exactly that pattern.
audit.why: 57.27% over 674 games with a real early dip; a flat row of 'Skill' hides the two windows the advice is built on.
audit.corrected: All five rows set to the packet sides in both layers with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why named the item spike but not what it beats; the anti-heal timing that actually decides it was absent.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul heals on a flat 5s cooldown and applies on-hit, so raw damage alone does not settle an extended trade.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now pairs Blade of the Ruined King with Grievous Wounds against the 5s heal.

audit.why: Thundering Smash at 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s is the punishable window and is now stated numerically; Stormbringer's 160s at rank 1 added at level 6.

edits.before: Q tumble resets make your spacing untouchable. Only take the trade when Volibear's Thundering Smash is down.
edits.after: Thundering Smash comes online and Frenzied Maul heals every 5s — give ground and last-hit rather than trade.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Volibear must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Sky Splitter (E) reaches 1200 and shields him inside its blast — he wins level 3 and you have no answer to it yet.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Thundering Smash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1 and only stuns the first target he attacks — space it out, then free-hit him.

edits.before: Level 4 is skill-defined, decided by whether you dodge his Q and space his path.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours: Thundering Smash is 12s and you out-range every step-up.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Volibear's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stormbringer leaps 550 over walls, slows, and disables your turret — at 160s it is his one chance, so never sit low while it is up.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Thundering Smash's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King plus Grievous Wounds out-races Frenzied Maul's 5s heal — force fights the moment it completes.

edits.before: Level 3 is firmly his — Thundering Smash root into Frenzied Maul chains hard.
edits.after: Level 3 is firmly his — Thundering Smash stuns, then Frenzied Maul heals.

edits.before: Volibear's early is his strongest: Thundering Smash (Q) gives him a movement-speed ramp and a root when he reaches you, and Frenzied Maul (W) heals and shreds while he's on you. If his Q connects you eat the root plus a full W chain, so kite pre-emptively and Condemn him mid-Q to cancel the dash-root before it lands.
edits.after: Volibear's early is his strongest: Thundering Smash (Q) ramps his move speed and stuns the first target he attacks, and Frenzied Maul (W) heals him off you every 5s. It is not a dash, so there is nothing to interrupt — break the chase instead. Kite pre-emptively, stay outside his 300 range, and buy Executioner's Calling before you contest a long trade.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are Volibear's: Q dash-root into W heal-and-shred beats you if he lands it, and level 6 Stormbringer adds a wall-hopping all-in. Level 4 is a spacing coin-flip — dodge his Q, don't sit in his path, and survive to items.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 are Volibear's: Q stun into W heal-and-shred beats you if he lands it, and Sky Splitter shields him inside the blast. Levels 4-5 swing back — Thundering Smash is 12s, so free-hit him whenever it is spent.

edits.before: From first item on you retake the lane — true-damage Bolts out-chunk his sustain and Final Hour dodges his engage. Only Q-root into R kills you, so save Condemn for his dash and keep a wall behind him.
edits.after: From first item on you retake the lane — Grievous Wounds beats Frenzied Maul and Final Hour dodges his engage. Only a Q stun into Stormbringer kills you, so hold Condemn for his leap and keep a wall behind him.

edits.before: Condemn his Thundering Smash (Q) to cancel the dash-root
edits.after: Break spacing before Thundering Smash (Q) stuns you

edits.before: Land Q root then chain Frenzied Maul (W)
edits.after: Land Q stun then chain Frenzied Maul (W)

edits.before: His engage stun. Condemn or tumble it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1 — engage only in the window after it.

edits.before: Volibear wastes Thundering Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Q only stuns the first target he attacks — Condemn breaks the chase after.

edits.before: That is Volibear's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The stun lands on his first auto after Q — his 300 range is the line to hold.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Sky Splitter (E) shields him mid-trade — his level-3 all-in beats you.

notes: The 'dash-root' error was systemic across this matchup (spikes[0].text, mid, late, whys[2], wants.you[0], wants.foe[0]) — Thundering Smash is a speed ramp with a stun on the next attack, not a dash and not a root, so the old advice to Condemn it mid-cast was actively harmful. Whether Vayne's Condemn knockback removes the pending Q stun buff is not in Riot's text and is not asserted.
